tools.name: convert_statement
tools.description: Upload a bank statement (PDF, CSV, XLS, XLSX, or OFX) as base64 and run AI extraction + categorisation. Returns a session_id plus access.level: "full" when an API key with credit was supplied, otherwise "preview" (5 sample rows, other rows masked) with an unlock_url a human can open to buy the full

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a conversion job by session_id. Status is processing, complete, or error.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Fetch categorised transactions and a spending summary for a completed session. Preview sessions return 5 sample rows, locked_rows (date, category, masked description) for the rest, and unlock_url.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "convert_statement" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
